senses.zh_definition: 指称尚未确定的专名字符串；现有材料不足以确立其马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: An unresolved proper-name token with no verified Malay common-word meaning.
senses.ms_definition: Token nama khas yang rujukannya belum dikenal pasti daripada bahan yang diberikan; bukan takrif kata umum bahasa Melayu yang telah disahkan.
senses.nuances: noun 为暂定的专名分类。SouthJet 出现在航空企业名称中，Southjet 也有其他专名用例，不能仅凭小写词形认定具体对象。status 因此不能据实标为 official。下列组合和例句仅演示如何讨论该字符串，并非高频搭配。[SouthJet Aviation 官方网站](https://www.southjetaviation.com/)；[日本中央竞马会：Southjet](https://sp.jra.jp/JRADB/accessU.html?CNAME=sj01ude101983109004%2FE4)。

etymology.historical_story: The packet does not establish an etymology for this token. SouthJet is used in an aviation business name, while Southjet also appears as a registered racehorse name. These independent uses show why a name's referent must be recovered before its history is written. Its appearance alone cannot establish a Malay borrowing or meaning. [SouthJet Aviation](https://www.southjetaviation.com/); [JRA record](https://sp.jra.jp/JRADB/accessU.html?CNAME=sj01ude101983109004%2FE4).
